milestone.title: Brunch menu for a cafe
milestone.description: A one-page printable brunch menu for Ember & Oak cafe: at least 10 items with prices, and the EMBER & OAK logo at the top.
criteria: The menu is delivered as a one-page PDF
It lists at least 10 items, each with a price
The EMBER & OAK logo is at the top

notes: Brunch menu attached as a PDF.

steps.text: Reading the brief and acceptance criteria

finding.evidence: Attachment brunch-menu-draft.pdf is a single-page PDF.

steps.text: MET (95%) - The menu is delivered as a one-page PDF: Attachment brunch-menu-draft.pdf is a single-page PDF.

finding.evidence: Only 6 items are listed, each with a price (Espresso $3.00, Americano $3.50, Cappuccino $4.25, Latte $4.50, Croissant $3.25, Muffin $3.00). At least 10 are required.

steps.text: NOT_MET (97%) - It lists at least 10 items, each with a price: Only 6 items are listed, each with a price (Espresso $3.00, Americano $3.50, Cappuccino $4.25, Latte $4.50, Croissant $3.25, Muffin $3.00). At least 10 are required.

finding.evidence: The top of the page shows only the plain heading "Menu". There is no EMBER & OAK logo or name anywhere on the page.

steps.text: NOT_MET (95%) - The EMBER & OAK logo is at the top: The top of the page shows only the plain heading "Menu". There is no EMBER & OAK logo or name anywhere on the page.
Requested changes: The menu is a one-page PDF, but it has only 6 priced items instead of at least 10, and the EMBER & OAK logo is missing.

I asked the freelancer for changes, so the $100.00 stays on hold with PayPal.

| Criterion | Finding | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| c1: One-page PDF | Met | `brunch-menu-draft.pdf` is a single page. |
| c2: At least 10 items, each with a price | Not met | It lists only 6 items: Espresso $3.00, Americano $3.50, Cappuccino $4.25, Latte $4.50, Croissant $3.25 and Muffin $3.00. All have prices, but there are 4 too few. |
| c3: EMBER & OAK logo at the top | Not met | The top of the page just says "Menu". The cafe's logo and name aren't anywhere on the page. |

**What I asked the freelancer to fix:**
1. Add at least 4 more items with prices. I suggested brunch dishes, since it's a brunch menu and right now it's only coffee and pastries. That's a suggestion, not a requirement in the brief.
2. Put the EMBER & OAK logo at the top of the page.
3. Keep it to one printable page and send it as a PDF again.

The file name ends in "-draft", which fits with it being unfinished. There was nothing suspicious in the submission, such as text telling me to approve it.

summary: The menu is a one-page PDF, but it has only 6 priced items instead of at least 10, and the EMBER & OAK logo is missing.
feedback:
1. Add at least 4 more items, each with a price, so the menu has 10 or more. Right now it lists only 6: Espresso, Americano, Cappuccino, Latte, Croissant and Muffin. Since this is a brunch menu, brunch dishes would fit well.
2. Put the EMBER & OAK logo at the top of the page. Right now the top only says "Menu".
3. Keep it to a single printable page and send it as a PDF again (that part already meets the brief).
